    .team-carousel-wrapper {
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .team-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: var(--space-4);
      transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
    }

    .team-card {
      flex: 0 0 340px;
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .team-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent-blue);

    .team-card-image {

    .team-card-quote {

    .team-card-name {

      font-weight: 700;

    .team-card-title {
      font-size: 13px;

      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--accent-blue);
      transition: gap var(--transition);

    .team-card-contact:hover {

    .team-card-contact svg {
      width: 14px;
      height: 14px;
    }

    .team-nav {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: var(--space-3);
      margin-top: var(--space-6);
    }

    .team-arrow {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--text-primary);

      align-items: center;

    .team-arrow:disabled {
      opacity: 0.3;

    /* ============ WORK SECTION ============ */
    .work {
      padding: var(--space-8) 0;

    }

    .work-carousel-wrapper {
      position: relative;
    }

    .work-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: var(--space-5);
      padding: var(--space-4) 0;
      overflow-x: auto;
      scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
      scrollbar-width: none;
      -ms-overflow-style: none;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    }

    .work-track::-webkit-scrollbar {

    .work-card {
      flex: 0 0 380px;
      scroll-snap-align: start;
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);

      transition: all var(--transition);

    .work-card:hover {

    .work-card-image {
      aspect-ratio: 16/10;
      background: var(--bg-elevated);
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
    }

    .work-card-image img {

      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      transition: transform var(--transition);
    }

    .work-card:hover .work-card-image img {
      transform: scale(1.05);
    }

    .work-card-badge {
      position: absolute;
      top: var(--space-3);
      left: var(--space-3);
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }

    .work-card-body {
      padding: var(--space-5);
    }

    .work-card-client {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--accent-amber);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-2);
    }

    .work-card-title {
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-3);
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .work-card-quote {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      line-height: 1.6;
      font-style: italic;
    }

    .work-nav {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: var(--space-3);
      margin-top: var(--space-5);
    }

    /* ============ CTA BANNER ============ */
    .cta-banner {
      padding: var(--space-8) 0;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bg-surface) 0%, var(--bg-base) 100%);

      text-align: center;
    }

    .cta-title {
      font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 64px);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -2px;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-4);

    .cta-body {
      font-size: 18px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      max-width: 600px;
      margin: 0 auto var(--space-6);
      line-height: 1.7;

    .cta-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-3);
      background: var(--accent-blue);
      color: #fff;
      padding: 16px 36px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 600;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .cta-btn:hover {
      background: var(--accent-blue-muted);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 15px 40px rgba(79, 143, 255, 0.35);
    }

    /* ============ HOW WE WORK ============ */
    .how-we-work {
      padding: var(--space-8) 0;
      background: var(--bg-base);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border-light);
    }

      gap: var(--space-6);

    @media (min-width: 1024px) {

    .how-we-work-content .section-tag {

    .how-we-work-title {

      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -1.5px;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-4);
      line-height: 1.1;

    .how-we-work-body {
      font-size: 17px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.8;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-5);

    .how-we-work-visual {
      aspect-ratio: 1;

      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .how-we-work-visual::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, rgba(79, 143, 255, 0.15) 0%, transparent 50%),

    .how-we-work-visual-inner {
      position: relative;
      text-align: center;
      padding: var(--space-5);
    }

    .how-we-work-visual-inner svg {
      width: 80px;
      height: 80px;
      color: var(--accent-blue);
      margin-bottom: var(--space-4);
    }

    .how-we-work-visual-inner p {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    /* ============ INSIGHTS ============ */
    .insights {
      padding: var(--space-8) 0;
      background: #080808;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border-light);
    }

    .insights-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: var(--space-4);
    }

    @media (min-width: 640px) {
      .insights-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      }
    }

    @media (min-width: 1024px) {
      .insights-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      }
    }

      background: var(--bg-surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .insight-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent-blue);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .insight-card-image {
      aspect-ratio: 16/9;
      background: var(--bg-elevated);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .insight-card-image img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      filter: grayscale(30%) brightness(0.8);
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .insight-card:hover .insight-card-image img {
      filter: grayscale(0%) brightness(0.9);
    }

    .insight-card-body {
      padding: var(--space-4);
    }

    .insight-card-type {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--accent-blue);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-2);
    }

    .insight-card-title {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      line-height: 1.4;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-3);
    }

    .insight-card-cta {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--accent-blue);
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-1);

    .insight-card-cta svg {
      width: 12px;
      height: 12px;
      transition: transform var(--transition);
    }

    .insight-card:hover .insight-card-cta svg {
      transform: translateX(3px);
    }

    /* ============ PRINCIPLES ============ */
    .principles {
      padding: var(--space-8) 0;
      background: var(--bg-base);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border-light);
    }

    .principles-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: var(--space-4);
    }

    @media (min-width: 640px) {
      .principles-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      }
    }

    @media (min-width: 1024px) {
      .principles-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      }
    }

    .principle-card {
      padding: var(--space-6);
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      transition: all var(--transition);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .principle-card::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: 3px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-blue), var(--accent-amber));
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity var(--transition);
    }

    .principle-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent-blue);
      transform: translateY(-4px);
    }

    .principle-card:hover::before {
      opacity: 1;
    }

    .principle-number {
      font-size: 48px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: var(--bg-elevated);
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-3);
    }

    .principle-title {
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-3);
    }

    .principle-desc {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    /* ============ FOOTER ============ */
    .footer {
      background: #050505;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      padding: var(--space-8) 0 var(--space-4);
    }

    .footer-ctas {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: var(--space-4);
      margin-bottom: var(--space-7);
    }

    @media (min-width: 768px) {
      .footer-ctas {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      }
    }

    .footer-cta {
      padding: var(--space-6);

      border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);

      line-height: 1.6;

      font-weight: 600;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;

      background: var(--accent-blue);
      color: #fff;
    }

    .footer-btn-primary:hover {
      background: var(--accent-blue-muted);
      transform: translateY(-2px);

    .footer-btn-secondary {
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--text-primary);

    .footer-btn-secondary:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent-blue);
      color: var(--accent-blue);
    }

      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: var(--space-4);

      border-top: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      margin-bottom: var(--space-4);

      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      transition: color var(--transition);

    .footer-links a:hover {
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    .footer-bottom {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-3);
    }

    .footer-legal {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    .footer-legal-links {
      display: flex;
      gap: var(--space-4);

    .footer-legal-links a {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      transition: color var(--transition);
    }

    .footer-legal-links a:hover {
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    .cookie-banner {
      position: fixed;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      background: var(--bg-elevated);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: var(--space-4) var(--space-5);
      z-index: 200;
      transform: translateY(100%);
      transition: transform var(--transition);
    }

    .cookie-banner.active {
      transform: translateY(0);

      max-width: 1280px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: var(--space-4);
    }

    .cookie-text {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      flex: 1;
      min-width: 280px;
    }

    .cookie-text a {
      color: var(--accent-blue);
      text-decoration: underline;
    }

    .cookie-actions {
      display: flex;
      gap: var(--space-3);
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .cookie-btn {
      padding: 10px 20px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      border: none;
    }

    .cookie-btn-accept {
      background: var(--accent-blue);
      color: #fff;
    }

    .cookie-btn-accept:hover {
      background: var(--accent-blue-muted);
    }

    .cookie-btn-decline {
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    .cookie-btn-decline:hover {
      border-color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    .cookie-btn-settings {
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }

    .cookie-btn-settings:hover {
      border-color: var(--text-muted);
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    /* ============ ANIMATIONS ============ */
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
      .fade-in {
        animation: fadeIn 0.6s ease-out forwards;
      }

      @keyframes fadeIn {
        from {
          opacity: 0;
          transform: translateY(20px);
        }
        to {
          opacity: 1;
          transform: translateY(0);
        }
      }
    }

    /* ============ RESPONSIVE ============ */
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .container {
        padding: 0 var(--space-4);
      }

      .team-card {
        flex: 0 0 300px;
      }

      .work-card {
        flex: 0 0 320px;
      }

      .hero-title {
        letter-spacing: -1px;
      }

      .section-title {
        letter-spacing: -1px;
      }

      .how-we-work-grid {
        gap: var(--space-5);
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .team-card {
        flex: 0 0 280px;
      }

      .work-card {
        flex: 0 0 280px;
      }

      .region-tabs {
        gap: var(--space-2);
      }

      .region-tab {
        padding: 8px 14px;
        font-size: 13px;
      }
    }

    /* ============ PLACEHOLDER IMAGES ============ */
    .placeholder-img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bg-elevated) 0%, var(--bg-surface) 100%);
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .placeholder-img svg {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      opacity: 0.5;
    }
  </style>
</head>

        <button class="cookie-btn cookie-btn-accept" id="cookieAccept">Accept all</button>
        <button class="cookie-btn cookie-btn-decline" id="cookieDecline">Decline all</button>
        <button class="cookie-btn cookie-btn-settings" id="cookieSettings">Manage settings</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <script>
    // ============ HERO CAROUSEL ============
    (function() {
      const track = document.getElementById('heroTrack');
      const dots = document.querySelectorAll('.hero-dot');
      const prevBtn = document.getElementById('heroPrev');
      const nextBtn = document.getElementById('heroNext');
      let currentSlide = 0;
      const totalSlides = 5;
      let autoplayInterval;

      function goToSlide(index) {
        if (index < 0) index = totalSlides - 1;
        if (index >= totalSlides) index = 0;
        currentSlide = index;
        track.style.transform = `translateX(-${currentSlide * 100}%)`;
        dots.forEach((dot, i) => {
          dot.classList.toggle('active', i === currentSlide);
        });
      }

      function nextSlide() {
        goToSlide(currentSlide + 1);
      }

      function prevSlide() {
        goToSlide(currentSlide - 1);
      }

      function startAutoplay() {
        autoplayInterval = setInterval(nextSlide, 6000);
      }

      function stopAutoplay() {
        clearInterval(autoplayInterval);
      }

      nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { stopAutoplay(); nextSlide(); startAutoplay(); });
      prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { stopAutoplay(); prevSlide(); startAutoplay(); });
      dots.forEach(dot => {
        dot.addEventListener('click', () => {
          stopAutoplay();
          goToSlide(parseInt(dot.dataset.index));
          startAutoplay();
        });
      });

      track.addEventListener('mouseenter', stopAutoplay);
      track.addEventListener('mouseleave', startAutoplay);

      startAutoplay();
    })();

    // ============ TEAM CAROUSEL ============
    (function() {
      const teamData = {
        'north-america': [
          { name: 'Denice Alvarez', title: 'Office Manager', office: 'New York', quote: 'As the Office Manager, I engage with teams from every discipline, and have learned so much through my day-to-day interactions with my fellow leapers.' },
          { name: 'Marco Bellini', title: 'Design Director', office: 'San Francisco', quote: 'Every day we are delighted by the immense beauty that nature holds. When engaged in the act of creation, it is our responsibility to channel that delight into the things we make.' }
        ],
        'asia': [
          { name: 'Priya Mehta', title: 'Studio Head', office: 'Bangalore', quote: 'We bring your brand vision to life, with transformative ideas and impactful marketing campaigns fueled by creativity and enthusiasm.' },
          { name: 'Thierry Lam', title: 'Design Lead', office: 'Singapore', quote: 'Good design is multifaceted. It impacts functionality, aesthetics, strategy, environment, business and so much more. Great design is seamless.' }
        ],
        'europe': [
          { name: 'Gavin Hartley', title: 'Managing Director', office: 'London', quote: "It's my job to make sure we innovate and push the boundaries when collaborating with brands to create inspiring customer experiences that deliver great business results." },
          { name: 'Francesca Terzi', title: 'Design Director', office: 'Munich', quote: 'At Leap Studio, I am constantly amazed by the talent I am surrounded with. We love to dream big and bring those dreams to life.' }
        ],
        'oceania': [
          { name: 'Jacintha Soo Ho', title: 'Senior Manager, CX Transformation', office: 'Melbourne', quote: 'I love helping clients see beyond their assumptions and showing them opportunities they haven\'t thought of before.' }
        ]
      };

      const track = document.getElementById('teamTrack');
      const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.region-tab');
      const prevBtn = document.getElementById('teamPrev');
      const nextBtn = document.getElementById('teamNext');
      let currentRegion = 'north-america';
      let teamIndex = 0;

      function renderTeam(region) {
        const members = teamData[region];
        track.innerHTML = members.map((m, i) => `
          <div class="team-card">
            <div class="team-card-image">
              <div class="placeholder-img">
                <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5">
                  <circle cx="12" cy="8" r="4"/>
                  <path d="M4 20c0-4 4-6 8-6s8 2 8 6"/>
                </svg>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="team-card-body">
              <p class="team-card-quote">${m.quote}</p>
              <h4 class="team-card-name">${m.name}</h4>
              <p class="team-card-title">${m.title}</p>
              <a href="#" class="team-card-contact">
                Contact Leap Studio ${m.office}
                <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M5 12h14M12 5l7 7-7 7"/></svg>
              </a>
            </div>
          </div>
        `).join('');
        teamIndex = 0;
        updateTeamNav();
      }

      function scrollTeam(direction) {
        const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.team-card');
        const cardWidth = cards[0] ? cards[0].offsetWidth + 24 : 364;
        const maxIndex = Math.max(0, cards.length - Math.floor(track.parentElement.offsetWidth / cardWidth));
        teamIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxIndex, teamIndex + direction));
        track.style.transform = `translateX(-${teamIndex * cardWidth}px)`;
        updateTeamNav();
      }

      function updateTeamNav() {
        const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.team-card');
        const cardWidth = cards[0] ? cards[0].offsetWidth + 24 : 364;
        const maxIndex = Math.max(0, cards.length - Math.floor(track.parentElement.offsetWidth / cardWidth));
        prevBtn.disabled = teamIndex === 0;
        nextBtn.disabled = teamIndex >= maxIndex;
      }

      tabs.forEach(tab => {
        tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
          tabs.forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
          tab.classList.add('active');
          currentRegion = tab.dataset.region;
          renderTeam(currentRegion);
        });
      });

      prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => scrollTeam(-1));
      nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => scrollTeam(1));

      renderTeam(currentRegion);

      window.addEventListener('resize', updateTeamNav);
    })();

    // ============ WORK CAROUSEL ============
    (function() {
      const track = document.getElementById('workTrack');
      const prevBtn = document.getElementById('workPrev');
      const nextBtn = document.getElementById('workNext');
      const scrollAmount = 405;

      prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        track.scrollBy({ left: -scrollAmount, behavior: 'smooth' });
      });

      nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        track.scrollBy({ left: scrollAmount, behavior: 'smooth' });
      });
    })();

    // ============ LANGUAGE SELECTOR ============
    (function() {
      const btn = document.getElementById('langBtn');
      const dropdown = document.getElementById('langDropdown');
      const options = dropdown.querySelectorAll('.lang-option');
      const currentLang = document.getElementById('currentLang');
      let isOpen = false;

      btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        isOpen = !isOpen;
        dropdown.classList.toggle('active', isOpen);
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen);
        btn.querySelector('svg').style.transform = isOpen ? 'rotate(180deg)' : '';
      });

      options.forEach(opt => {
        opt.addEventListener('click', () => {
          options.forEach(o => o.classList.remove('active'));
          opt.classList.add('active');
          currentLang.textContent = opt.textContent;
          isOpen = false;
          dropdown.classList.remove('active');
          btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', false);
          btn.querySelector('svg').style.transform = '';
        });
      });

      document.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (isOpen) {
          isOpen = false;
          dropdown.classList.remove('active');
          btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', false);
          btn.querySelector('svg').style.transform = '';
        }
      });
    })();

    // ============ MOBILE MENU ============
    (function() {
      const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
      const mobileMenu = document.getElementById('mobileMenu');

      hamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
        mobileMenu.classList.toggle('active');
      });

      mobileMenu.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(link => {
        link.addEventListener('click', () => {
          mobileMenu.classList.remove('active');
        });
      });
    })();

    // ============ COOKIE BANNER ============
    (function() {
      const banner = document.getElementById('cookieBanner');
      const acceptBtn = document.getElementById('cookieAccept');
      const declineBtn = document.getElementById('cookieDecline');
      const settingsBtn = document.getElementById('cookieSettings');

      const cookieKey = 'leap_studio_cookies';
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(cookieKey);

      if (!saved) {
        setTimeout(() => {
          banner.classList.add('active');
        }, 1500);
      }

      function hideBanner() {
        banner.classList.remove('active');
      }

      acceptBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        localStorage.setItem(cookieKey, 'accepted');
        hideBanner();
      });

      declineBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        localStorage.setItem(cookieKey, 'declined');
        hideBanner();
      });

      settingsBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        localStorage.setItem(cookieKey, 'settings');
        hideBanner();
      });
    })();

    // ============ SMOOTH SCROLL ============
    (function() {
      document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(anchor => {
        anchor.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          const target = document.querySelector(this.getAttribute('href'));
          if (target) {
            e.preventDefault();
            target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
          }
        });
      });
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

  <style>

    .lang-option {

    .work-card-client {

    .work-card-title {
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-3);
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .work-card-quote {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      line-height: 1.6;

      gap: var(--space-3);
      background: var(--accent-blue);
      color: #fff;

      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 600;

      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 15px 40px rgba(79, 143, 255, 0.35);

    /* ============ HOW WE WORK ============ */
    .how-we-work {
      padding: var(--space-8) 0;

    .how-we-work-content .section-tag {

    .how-we-work-title {

      font-weight: 800;

    .how-we-work-body {

      margin-bottom: var(--space-5);

      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;

    .how-we-work-visual::before {

    .how-we-work-visual-inner {

      padding: var(--space-5);

    .how-we-work-visual-inner svg {
      width: 80px;

      border-top: 1px solid var(--border-light);

    @media (min-width: 640px) {

    .insight-card:hover {

    .insight-card-image {

    .insight-card-title {

      line-height: 1.4;

    .principles-grid {

      gap: var(--space-4);
    }

    @media (min-width: 640px) {

    .cookie-banner {

    .cookie-actions {

      background: var(--accent-blue);
      color: #fff;

      color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    .cookie-btn-decline:hover {
      border-color: var(--text-muted);

    .cookie-btn-settings {

      border-color: var(--text-muted);

        from {
          opacity: 0;
          transform: translateY(20px);
        }
        to {
          opacity: 1;
          transform: translateY(0);
        }
      }
    }

    /* ============ RESPONSIVE ============ */
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .container {
        padding: 0 var(--space-4);

    }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {

      }

      font-size: 12px;

      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      opacity: 0.5;
    }

  <script>
    // ============ HERO CAROUSEL ============
    (function() {
      const track = document.getElementById('heroTrack');
      const dots = document.querySelectorAll('.hero-dot');
      const prevBtn = document.getElementById('heroPrev');
      const nextBtn = document.getElementById('heroNext');
      let currentSlide = 0;
      const totalSlides = 5;
      let autoplayInterval;

      function goToSlide(index) {
        if (index < 0) index = totalSlides - 1;
        if (index >= totalSlides) index = 0;
        currentSlide = index;
        track.style.transform = `translateX(-${currentSlide * 100}%)`;
        dots.forEach((dot, i) => {
          dot.classList.toggle('active', i === currentSlide);
        });
      }

      function nextSlide() {
        goToSlide(currentSlide + 1);
      }

      function prevSlide() {
        goToSlide(currentSlide - 1);
      }

      function startAutoplay() {
        autoplayInterval = setInterval(nextSlide, 6000);
      }

      function stopAutoplay() {
        clearInterval(autoplayInterval);
      }

      nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { stopAutoplay(); nextSlide(); startAutoplay(); });
      prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { stopAutoplay(); prevSlide(); startAutoplay(); });
      dots.forEach(dot => {
        dot.addEventListener('click', () => {
          stopAutoplay();
          goToSlide(parseInt(dot.dataset.index));
          startAutoplay();
        });
      });

      track.addEventListener('mouseenter', stopAutoplay);
      track.addEventListener('mouseleave', startAutoplay);

      startAutoplay();
    })();

            <div class="team-card-image">
              <div class="placeholder-img">
                <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5">
                  <circle cx="12" cy="8" r="4"/>
                  <path d="M4 20c0-4 4-6 8-6s8 2 8 6"/>
                </svg>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="team-card-body">
              <p class="team-card-quote">${m.quote}</p>
              <h4 class="team-card-name">${m.name}</h4>
              <p class="team-card-title">${m.title}</p>
              <a href="#" class="team-card-contact">
                Contact Leap Studio ${m.office}
                <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M5 12h14M12 5l7 7-7 7"/></svg>
              </a>
            </div>
          </div>
        `).join('');
        teamIndex = 0;
        updateTeamNav();
      }

      function scrollTeam(direction) {
        const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.team-card');
        const cardWidth = cards[0] ? cards[0].offsetWidth + 24 : 364;
        const maxIndex = Math.max(0, cards.length - Math.floor(track.parentElement.offsetWidth / cardWidth));
        teamIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxIndex, teamIndex + direction));
        track.style.transform = `translateX(-${teamIndex * cardWidth}px)`;
        updateTeamNav();
      }

      function updateTeamNav() {
        const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.team-card');
        const cardWidth = cards[0] ? cards[0].offsetWidth + 24 : 364;
        const maxIndex = Math.max(0, cards.length - Math.floor(track.parentElement.offsetWidth / cardWidth));
        prevBtn.disabled = teamIndex === 0;
        nextBtn.disabled = teamIndex >= maxIndex;
      }

      tabs.forEach(tab => {
        tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
          tabs.forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
          tab.classList.add('active');
          currentRegion = tab.dataset.region;
          renderTeam(currentRegion);
        });
      });

      prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => scrollTeam(-1));
      nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => scrollTeam(1));

      renderTeam(currentRegion);

      window.addEventListener('resize', updateTeamNav);
    })();

    // ============ WORK CAROUSEL ============
    (function() {
      const track = document.getElementById('workTrack');
      const prevBtn = document.getElementById('workPrev');
      const nextBtn = document.getElementById('workNext');
      const scrollAmount = 405;

      prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        track.scrollBy({ left: -scrollAmount, behavior: 'smooth' });
      });

      nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        track.scrollBy({ left: scrollAmount, behavior: 'smooth' });
      });
    })();

    // ============ LANGUAGE SELECTOR ============
    (function() {
      const btn = document.getElementById('langBtn');
      const dropdown = document.getElementById('langDropdown');
      const options = dropdown.querySelectorAll('.lang-option');
      const currentLang = document.getElementById('currentLang');
      let isOpen = false;

      btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        isOpen = !isOpen;
        dropdown.classList.toggle('active', isOpen);
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen);
        btn.querySelector('svg').style.transform = isOpen ? 'rotate(180deg)' : '';
      });

      options.forEach(opt => {
        opt.addEventListener('click', () => {
          options.forEach(o => o.classList.remove('active'));
          opt.classList.add('active');
          currentLang.textContent = opt.textContent;
          isOpen = false;
          dropdown.classList.remove('active');
          btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', false);
          btn.querySelector('svg').style.transform = '';
        });
      });

      document.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (isOpen) {
          isOpen = false;
          dropdown.classList.remove('active');
          btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', false);
          btn.querySelector('svg').style.transform = '';
        }
      });
    })();

    // ============ MOBILE MENU ============
    (function() {
      const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
      const mobileMenu = document.getElementById('mobileMenu');

      hamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
        mobileMenu.classList.toggle('active');
      });

      mobileMenu.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(link => {
        link.addEventListener('click', () => {
          mobileMenu.classList.remove('active');
        });
      });
    })();

    // ============ COOKIE BANNER ============
    (function() {
      const banner = document.getElementById('cookieBanner');
      const acceptBtn = document.getElementById('cookieAccept');
      const declineBtn = document.getElementById('cookieDecline');
      const settingsBtn = document.getElementById('cookieSettings');

      const cookieKey = 'leap_studio_cookies';
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(cookieKey);

      if (!saved) {
        setTimeout(() => {
          banner.classList.add('active');
        }, 1500);
      }

      function hideBanner() {
        banner.classList.remove('active');
      }

      acceptBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        localStorage.setItem(cookieKey, 'accepted');
        hideBanner();
      });

      declineBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        localStorage.setItem(cookieKey, 'declined');
        hideBanner();
      });

      settingsBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        localStorage.setItem(cookieKey, 'settings');
        hideBanner();
      });
    })();

    // ============ SMOOTH SCROLL ============
    (function() {
      document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(anchor => {
        anchor.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          const target = document.querySelector(this.getAttribute('href'));
          if (target) {
            e.preventDefault();
            target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
          }
        });
      });
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Leap Studio — Your Reinvention and Experience Partner</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    :root {
      --bg-base: oklch(5% 0.005 265);
      --bg-surface: oklch(11% 0.008 265);
      --bg-elevated: oklch(15% 0.01 265);
      --text-primary: oklch(96% 0.008 265);
      --text-secondary: oklch(70% 0.015 265);
      --text-muted: oklch(50% 0.02 265);
      --accent-blue: oklch(65% 0.2 265);
      --accent-amber: oklch(75% 0.16 50);
      --accent-blue-muted: oklch(55% 0.15 265);
      --border: oklch(20% 0.015 265);
      --border-light: oklch(16% 0.01 265);
      --space-1: 4px;
      --space-2: 8px;
      --space-3: 16px;
      --space-4: 24px;
      --space-5: 32px;
      --space-6: 48px;
      --space-7: 64px;
      --space-8: 96px;
      --radius-sm: 6px;
      --radius-md: 12px;
      --radius-lg: 20px;
      --font-sans: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif;
      --transition: 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
    }

    html {
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
    }

    body {
      font-family: var(--font-sans);
      background: #0A0A0A;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      line-height: 1.6;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }

    a {
      color: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    img {
      max-width: 100%;
      display: block;
    }

    .container {
      max-width: 1280px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 var(--space-5);
    }

    /* ============ NAVIGATION ============ */
    .nav {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      background: rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.85);
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
    }

    .nav-inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      height: 72px;
      padding: 0 var(--space-5);
      max-width: 1400px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .nav-logo {
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
    }

    .nav-logo span {
      color: var(--accent-blue);
    }

    .nav-links {
      display: none;
      gap: var(--space-5);
      list-style: none;
    }

    .nav-links a {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      transition: color var(--transition);
      position: relative;
    }

    .nav-links a::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -4px;
      left: 0;
      width: 0;
      height: 1px;
      background: var(--accent-blue);
      transition: width var(--transition);
    }

    .nav-links a:hover {
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    .nav-links a:hover::after {
      width: 100%;
    }

    .nav-right {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-4);
    }

    .lang-selector {
      position: relative;
    }

    .lang-btn {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-2);
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      padding: 8px 14px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 500;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .lang-btn:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent-blue);
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    .lang-btn svg {
      width: 14px;
      height: 14px;
      transition: transform var(--transition);
    }

    .lang-dropdown {
      position: absolute;
      top: calc(100% + 8px);
      right: 0;
      background: var(--bg-elevated);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: var(--space-2);
      min-width: 160px;
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      transform: translateY(-8px);
      transition: all var(--transition);
      box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    }

    .lang-dropdown.active {
      opacity: 1;
      visibility: visible;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    .lang-option {
      display: block;
      padding: 10px 14px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .lang-option:hover {
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    .lang-option.active {
      color: var(--accent-blue);
    }

    .hamburger {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 5px;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 8px;
    }

    .hamburger span {
      width: 22px;
      height: 2px;
      background: var(--text-primary);
      border-radius: 2px;
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .mobile-menu {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      top: 72px;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      background: var(--bg-base);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: var(--space-4) var(--space-5);
    }

    .mobile-menu.active {
      display: block;
    }

    .mobile-menu a {
      display: block;
      padding: var(--space-3) 0;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
    }

    .mobile-menu a:last-child {
      border-bottom: none;
    }

    @media (min-width: 1024px) {
      .nav-links {
        display: flex;
      }
      .hamburger {
        display: none;
      }
    }

    /* ============ HERO CAROUSEL ============ */
    .hero {
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      padding-top: 72px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .hero-bg {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 50%, rgba(79, 143, 255, 0.08) 0%, transparent 50%),
                  radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 80%, rgba(255, 179, 71, 0.05) 0%, transparent 40%);
    }

    .hero-inner {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      width: 100%;
    }

    .hero-carousel {
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .hero-track {
      display: flex;
      transition: transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
    }

    .hero-slide {
      flex: 0 0 100%;
      padding: var(--space-6) 0;
    }

    .hero-content {
      max-width: 800px;
    }

    .hero-tag {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-2);
      background: var(--bg-elevated);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--accent-blue);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-5);
    }

    .hero-title {
      font-size: clamp(36px, 6vw, 72px);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.05;
      letter-spacing: -2px;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-4);
    }

    .hero-desc {
      font-size: 18px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      max-width: 560px;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-6);
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    .hero-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-3);
      background: var(--accent-blue);
      color: #fff;
      padding: 14px 28px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 600;
      transition: all var(--transition);

      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .hero-cta:hover {
      background: var(--accent-blue-muted);

    }

    .hero-nav {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-4);
      margin-top: var(--space-6);
    }

    .hero-dots {
      display: flex;
      gap: var(--space-2);
    }

    .hero-dot {
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      border-radius: 50%;

      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all var(--transition);

    .hero-dot.active {

      border-radius: 4px;
      background: var(--accent-blue);
    }

    .hero-arrow {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);

      color: var(--text-primary);

      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .hero-arrow:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent-blue);
      background: var(--accent-blue);
      color: #fff;
    }

    .hero-arrow svg {
      width: 18px;
      height: 18px;
    }

    /* ============ TEAM SECTION ============ */
    .team {
      padding: var(--space-8) 0;
      background: var(--bg-base);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border-light);
    }

    .section-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-7);
    }

    .section-tag {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--accent-blue);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 1.5px;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-3);
    }

    .section-title {
      font-size: clamp(32px, 5vw, 56px);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -1.5px;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-3);
    }

    .section-subtitle {
      font-size: 18px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      max-width: 600px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .region-tabs {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: var(--space-2);
      margin-bottom: var(--space-6);
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .region-tab {
      padding: 10px 20px;
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 100px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 500;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .region-tab:hover {
      border-color: var(--text-muted);
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    .region-tab.active {
      background: var(--accent-blue);
      border-color: var(--accent-blue);
      color: #fff;
    }

    .team-carousel-wrapper {
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .team-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: var(--space-4);
      transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
    }

    .team-card {
      flex: 0 0 340px;
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .team-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent-blue);

    .team-card-image {

      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .team-card-image img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      filter: grayscale(20%) brightness(0.9);
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .team-card:hover .team-card-image img {
      filter: grayscale(0%) brightness(1);
      transform: scale(1.05);
    }

    .team-card-body {
      padding: var(--space-5);
    }

    .team-card-quote {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-style: italic;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-4);
      position: relative;
      padding-left: var(--space-4);
    }

    .team-card-quote::before {
      content: '"';
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      top: -4px;
      font-size: 32px;
      color: var(--accent-blue);
      font-family: Georgia, serif;
    }

    .team-card-name {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-1);
    }

    .team-card-title {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      margin-bottom: var(--space-3);
    }

    .team-card-contact {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-2);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--accent-blue);
      transition: gap var(--transition);
    }

    .team-card-contact:hover {
      gap: var(--space-3);
    }

    .team-card-contact svg {
      width: 14px;
      height: 14px;
    }

    .team-nav {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: var(--space-3);
      margin-top: var(--space-6);
    }

    .team-arrow {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .team-arrow:hover:not(:disabled) {
      border-color: var(--accent-blue);
      background: var(--accent-blue);
      color: #fff;
    }

    .team-arrow:disabled {
      opacity: 0.3;
      cursor: not-allowed;
    }

    .team-arrow svg {
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
    }

    /* ============ WORK SECTION ============ */
    .work {
      padding: var(--space-8) 0;
      background: #080808;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .work-carousel-wrapper {
      position: relative;
    }

    .work-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: var(--space-5);
      padding: var(--space-4) 0;
      overflow-x: auto;
      scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
      scrollbar-width: none;
      -ms-overflow-style: none;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    }

    .work-track::-webkit-scrollbar {
      display: none;
    }

    .work-card {
      flex: 0 0 380px;
      scroll-snap-align: start;
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .work-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent-amber);
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
    }

    .work-card-image {
      aspect-ratio: 16/10;
      background: var(--bg-elevated);
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
    }

    .work-card-image img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      transition: transform var(--transition);
    }

    .work-card:hover .work-card-image img {
      transform: scale(1.05);
    }

    .work-card-badge {
      position: absolute;
      top: var(--space-3);
      left: var(--space-3);
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }

    .work-card-body {
      padding: var(--space-5);
    }

    .work-card-client {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--accent-amber);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-2);
    }

    .work-card-title {
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-3);
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .work-card-quote {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      line-height: 1.6;
      font-style: italic;
    }

    .work-nav {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: var(--space-3);
      margin-top: var(--space-5);
    }

    /* ============ CTA BANNER ============ */
    .cta-banner {
      padding: var(--space-8) 0;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bg-surface) 0%, var(--bg-base) 100%);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      text-align: center;
    }

    .cta-title {
      font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 64px);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -2px;

        to {
          opacity: 1;
          transform: translateY(0);

  <script>
    // ============ HERO CAROUSEL ============
    (function() {
      const track = document.getElementById('heroTrack');
      const dots = document.querySelectorAll('.hero-dot');
      const prevBtn = document.getElementById('heroPrev');
      const nextBtn = document.getElementById('heroNext');
      let currentSlide = 0;
      const totalSlides = 5;
      let autoplayInterval;

      function goToSlide(index) {
        if (index < 0) index = totalSlides - 1;
        if (index >= totalSlides) index = 0;
        currentSlide = index;
        track.style.transform = `translateX(-${currentSlide * 100}%)`;
        dots.forEach((dot, i) => {
          dot.classList.toggle('active', i === currentSlide);
        });
      }

      function nextSlide() {
        goToSlide(currentSlide + 1);
      }

      function prevSlide() {
        goToSlide(currentSlide - 1);
      }

      function startAutoplay() {
        autoplayInterval = setInterval(nextSlide, 6000);
      }

      function stopAutoplay() {
        clearInterval(autoplayInterval);
      }

      nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { stopAutoplay(); nextSlide(); startAutoplay(); });
      prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { stopAutoplay(); prevSlide(); startAutoplay(); });
      dots.forEach(dot => {
        dot.addEventListener('click', () => {
          stopAutoplay();
          goToSlide(parseInt(dot.dataset.index));
          startAutoplay();
        });
      });

      track.addEventListener('mouseenter', stopAutoplay);
      track.addEventListener('mouseleave', startAutoplay);

      startAutoplay();
    })();

    // ============ TEAM CAROUSEL ============
    (function() {
      const teamData = {
        'north-america': [
          { name: 'Denice Alvarez', title: 'Office Manager', office: 'New York', quote: 'As the Office Manager, I engage with teams from every discipline, and have learned so much through my day-to-day interactions with my fellow leapers.' },
          { name: 'Marco Bellini', title: 'Design Director', office: 'San Francisco', quote: 'Every day we are delighted by the immense beauty that nature holds. When engaged in the act of creation, it is our responsibility to channel that delight into the things we make.' }
        ],
        'asia': [
          { name: 'Priya Mehta', title: 'Studio Head', office: 'Bangalore', quote: 'We bring your brand vision to life, with transformative ideas and impactful marketing campaigns fueled by creativity and enthusiasm.' },
          { name: 'Thierry Lam', title: 'Design Lead', office: 'Singapore', quote: 'Good design is multifaceted. It impacts functionality, aesthetics, strategy, environment, business and so much more. Great design is seamless.' }
        ],
        'europe': [
          { name: 'Gavin Hartley', title: 'Managing Director', office: 'London', quote: "It's my job to make sure we innovate and push the boundaries when collaborating with brands to create inspiring customer experiences that deliver great business results." },
          { name: 'Francesca Terzi', title: 'Design Director', office: 'Munich', quote: 'At Leap Studio, I am constantly amazed by the talent I am surrounded with. We love to dream big and bring those dreams to life.' }
        ],
        'oceania': [
          { name: 'Jacintha Soo Ho', title: 'Senior Manager, CX Transformation', office: 'Melbourne', quote: 'I love helping clients see beyond their assumptions and showing them opportunities they haven\'t thought of before.' }
        ]
      };

      const track = document.getElementById('teamTrack');
      const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.region-tab');
      const prevBtn = document.getElementById('teamPrev');
      const nextBtn = document.getElementById('teamNext');
      let currentRegion = 'north-america';
      let teamIndex = 0;

      function renderTeam(region) {
        const members = teamData[region];
        track.innerHTML = members.map((m, i) => `
          <div class="team-card">
            <div class="team-card-image">
              <div class="placeholder-img">
                <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5">
                  <circle cx="12" cy="8" r="4"/>
                  <path d="M4 20c0-4 4-6 8-6s8 2 8 6"/>
                </svg>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="team-card-body">
              <p class="team-card-quote">${m.quote}</p>
              <h4 class="team-card-name">${m.name}</h4>
              <p class="team-card-title">${m.title}</p>
              <a href="#" class="team-card-contact">
                Contact Leap Studio ${m.office}
                <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M5 12h14M12 5l7 7-7 7"/></svg>
              </a>
            </div>
          </div>
        `).join('');
        teamIndex = 0;
        updateTeamNav();
      }

      function scrollTeam(direction) {
        const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.team-card');
        const cardWidth = cards[0] ? cards[0].offsetWidth + 24 : 364;
        const maxIndex = Math.max(0, cards.length - Math.floor(track.parentElement.offsetWidth / cardWidth));
        teamIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxIndex, teamIndex + direction));
        track.style.transform = `translateX(-${teamIndex * cardWidth}px)`;
        updateTeamNav();
      }

      function updateTeamNav() {
        const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.team-card');
        const cardWidth = cards[0] ? cards[0].offsetWidth + 24 : 364;
        const maxIndex = Math.max(0, cards.length - Math.floor(track.parentElement.offsetWidth / cardWidth));
        prevBtn.disabled = teamIndex === 0;
        nextBtn.disabled = teamIndex >= maxIndex;
      }

      tabs.forEach(tab => {
        tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
          tabs.forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
          tab.classList.add('active');
          currentRegion = tab.dataset.region;
          renderTeam(currentRegion);
        });
      });

      prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => scrollTeam(-1));
      nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => scrollTeam(1));

      renderTeam(currentRegion);

      window.addEventListener('resize', updateTeamNav);
    })();

    // ============ WORK CAROUSEL ============
    (function() {
      const track = document.getElementById('workTrack');
      const prevBtn = document.getElementById('workPrev');
      const nextBtn = document.getElementById('workNext');
      const scrollAmount = 405;

      prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        track.scrollBy({ left: -scrollAmount, behavior: 'smooth' });
      });

      nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        track.scrollBy({ left: scrollAmount, behavior: 'smooth' });
      });
    })();

    // ============ LANGUAGE SELECTOR ============
    (function() {
      const btn = document.getElementById('langBtn');
      const dropdown = document.getElementById('langDropdown');
      const options = dropdown.querySelectorAll('.lang-option');
      const currentLang = document.getElementById('currentLang');
      let isOpen = false;

      btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        isOpen = !isOpen;
        dropdown.classList.toggle('active', isOpen);
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen);
        btn.querySelector('svg').style.transform = isOpen ? 'rotate(180deg)' : '';
      });

      options.forEach(opt => {
        opt.addEventListener('click', () => {
          options.forEach(o => o.classList.remove('active'));
          opt.classList.add('active');
          currentLang.textContent = opt.textContent;
          isOpen = false;
          dropdown.classList.remove('active');
          btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', false);
          btn.querySelector('svg').style.transform = '';
        });
      });

      document.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (isOpen) {
          isOpen = false;
          dropdown.classList.remove('active');
          btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', false);
          btn.querySelector('svg').style.transform = '';
        }
      });
    })();

    // ============ MOBILE MENU ============
    (function() {
      const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
      const mobileMenu = document.getElementById('mobileMenu');

      hamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
        mobileMenu.classList.toggle('active');
      });

      mobileMenu.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(link => {
        link.addEventListener('click', () => {
          mobileMenu.classList.remove('active');
        });
      });
    })();

    // ============ COOKIE BANNER ============
    (function() {
      const banner = document.getElementById('cookieBanner');
      const acceptBtn = document.getElementById('cookieAccept');
      const declineBtn = document.getElementById('cookieDecline');
      const settingsBtn = document.getElementById('cookieSettings');

      const cookieKey = 'leap_studio_cookies';
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(cookieKey);

      if (!saved) {
        setTimeout(() => {
          banner.classList.add('active');
        }, 1500);
      }

      function hideBanner() {
        banner.classList.remove('active');
      }

      acceptBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        localStorage.setItem(cookieKey, 'accepted');
        hideBanner();
      });

      declineBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        localStorage.setItem(cookieKey, 'declined');
        hideBanner();
      });

      settingsBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        localStorage.setItem(cookieKey, 'settings');
        hideBanner();
      });
    })();

    // ============ SMOOTH SCROLL ============
    (function() {
      document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(anchor => {
        anchor.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          const target = document.querySelector(this.getAttribute('href'));
          if (target) {
            e.preventDefault();
            target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
          }
        });
      });
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
